_readme: Photography for the site. Images are served straight from the Pexels CDN;
nothing is copied into the repo, so the build stays zero-dependency and the
repo stays small. Pexels images are free to use under the Pexels licence and
attribution is not required, but every photo on this site is credited anyway.
match: "exact"     the photo shows this dish.
match: "reference" the photo shows the right family of dish or the main
ingredient, but is not that exact recipe. The page says so
in the caption. Never label a reference photo as exact —
it is the same rule as the un-kitchen-tested disclosure.
byCategory is the safety net: any recipe published without an entry in
`recipes` still gets a photo, chosen deterministically from its category pool
by slug, so a new recipe can never publish with a blank hero.
